title: The Dating, Splitting and Conversion of a Vacation Package Balance
content:
The balance on a package sold under Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products is dated from the departure date, split according to the payment plan the product carries, and converted at the product's own markup where the party elects another currency. Each product records its own figures.

## The figures recorded against each product

| Product | Balance due this many calendar days before departure | Instalments permitted | Number of instalments the balance may be split into | Price guarantee, in calendar days from the deposit | Conversion markup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | 28 | yes | 3 | 0 | 3.5 per cent |
| Flex Bundle Package | 35 | yes | 4 | 14 | 3.0 per cent |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | 45 | yes | 4 | 21 | 3.0 per cent |
| Escorted Tour Package | 60 | yes | 6 | 30 | 2.5 per cent |
| Ocean Cruise Package | 90 | no | 0 | 30 | 2.5 per cent |
| Luxury Collection Package | 90 | yes | 8 | 365 | 1.5 per cent |

## The same figures put as three questions the schedule answers

**How far before departure does the balance fall due on a package sold under the Escorted Tour Package?** Sixty calendar days before the departure date recorded on the package.

**Into how many instalments may the balance be split on the Luxury Collection Package?** Eight. A product recording no instalments, as the Ocean Cruise Package does with 0, carries no payment plan at all.

**What markup does the product carry where the party elects to be charged in a currency other than the operator's own?** The markup recorded in the last column, from 1.5 per cent on the Luxury Collection Package to 3.5 per cent on the Value Bundle Package.

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A package quoted under the Flex Bundle Package departing on the fourteenth of a month has its balance falling due 35 calendar days earlier. Its price guarantee term of 14 calendar days is counted from the deposit, and its conversion markup of 3.0 per cent is the figure added where the party elects another currency. A price guarantee figure of 0, as the Value Bundle Package records, is a term of no days at all.
